about.title: Hillsborough Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: Hillsborough is a quiet town of about 11,451 people in San Mateo County, and in the most recent final crash year, 2025, public records show 5 injury collisions, 7 people hurt, and no traffic deaths within its limits. That is worth stating plainly. Still, families here do lose loved ones to preventable events, whether on I-280 and its northbound lanes, along Skyline Boulevard or Crystal Springs Road, in a hospital or care facility, or on someone else's property. A wrongful death claim is the civil path California gives surviving family members. It stands apart from any criminal case, and it can move forward whether or not charges are ever filed. The law limits who may bring the claim, sets a two-year clock from the date of death, and allows recovery for funeral and burial costs, the financial support the person would have provided, and the loss of their love, companionship and guidance. LawProactive is not a law firm. We simply connect Hillsborough families with an independent attorney who handles these cases on contingency, so there is no fee unless there is a recovery.

whyChoose.title: Why Hillsborough Families Turn to LawProactive

items.title: Clarity on who can file
items.desc: California gives a spouse or domestic partner and children the first right to bring a wrongful death claim, with certain dependents and heirs eligible in other circumstances. An attorney can sort out standing early so the right people are protected.

items.title: The deadline is watched closely
items.desc: Most claims must be filed within two years of the date of death, and the window is far shorter when a government entity may be responsible. Connecting with counsel promptly keeps those dates from slipping.

items.title: Every category of loss is considered
items.desc: Recoverable losses reach beyond funeral and burial expenses to include lost financial support and the loss of love, companionship and guidance. The attorneys in our network work on contingency, so pursuing the full claim costs nothing up front.

items.question: Hillsborough recorded no traffic deaths in 2025. Can my family still have a wrongful death claim?
items.answer: Yes. The town's collision figures cover only crashes inside city limits, and many Hillsborough residents travel I-280, Skyline Boulevard and neighboring cities daily. Wrongful death claims also arise from medical negligence, care-facility neglect, unsafe property and defective products, none of which appear in traffic statistics. What matters is whether another party's carelessness caused the death.

items.question: The person responsible is facing criminal charges. Do we have to wait for that case to finish?
items.answer: No. A wrongful death claim is a civil action that runs separately from any criminal prosecution in San Mateo County. It has its own standard of proof and its own two-year deadline, which continues to run regardless of the criminal timeline. An attorney can often gather evidence while the criminal matter is pending.

items.question: What if a city, county or state agency may have played a role in the death?
items.answer: Claims against a government entity in California follow a much shorter timeline than the standard two years, and a formal administrative claim usually has to be submitted first. Missing that step can end the case before it begins. If a public agency, road design or government employee might be involved, speaking with an attorney right away is especially important.
